verdict: Meta drove all 32 leads over 28 days at a $12.12 CPL across $387.97 in spend, with "BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness" accounting for the majority at $228.24. The biggest movement is a -100% spend drop in the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days, suggesting Meta campaigns were paused or exhausted budget mid-period, which likely explains the -98.62% dip in Instagram activity as well. Note: Windsor shows 32 leads while GHL shows 37 opportunities created from 301 contacts, and these figures are unreconciled.

performance.verdict: Meta went dark Sep 16; pipeline shows 0 appointments despite 37 GHL opportunities.

findings.text: Meta spend dropped to $0 from Sep 16 onward (13 consecutive zero-spend days); all 32 leads and $387.97 spend occurred before that cutoff.
5 overdue milestones (Jul 23–Aug 31): phone-match attribution, sync cleanup, dashboard, and renewal scoreboard all unresolved — August prove-it month outcome unknown.
GHL shows 37 opportunities created from 301 contacts but 0 appointments and 0 won — 32 Meta leads arrived; intake pipeline is not converting, not an ads problem.
3-day signal (Sep 25–27): spend $0, leads 0, IG reach 0 vs prior 3 days (Sep 22–24) also $0 — channel has been fully dark for 16 days, not a temporary dip.
GBP delivering 87 calls and 222 actions over 28 days with 18.24% call rate — organic is holding while paid is dark, masking the true lead drought.

suggestions.text: Restore Meta spend immediately; 13 zero-spend days with no approved pause means budget exhausted or campaigns deactivated — confirm and reactivate.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has recorded $0 spend every day from Sep 16–28 (13 days), accounting for all 32 leads and $387.97 in the prior active period at a $12.12 CPL. Diagnose whether budget exhausted or campaigns were manually paused, then reactivate or refund budget to the active period. Success check: confirmed spend resuming within 1 business day and at least 2 leads recorded within 3 days of reactivation. Re-check Oct 1.

suggestions.text: Escalate intake leak: 37 GHL opportunities, 0 appointments, 0 won — audit contact-to-booking step before spending more on lead gen.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 37 opportunities created from 301 contacts but zero appointments and zero won deals as of Sep 28. This is an intake/CRM routing problem, not an ads problem — more spend will only worsen the waste. Assign Ahmed Memon or Ali Shaheer to trace one opportunity end-to-end through the GHL-to-Lily booking path. Success check: at least 5 opportunities have a confirmed appointment status by Oct 3.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP call volume weekly; if paid stays dark past Oct 1, organic 87 calls/28 days will be the only lead source — flag to Sohib.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP generated 87 calls and 222 total actions over 28 days at an 18.24% call rate, currently the only active lead channel while Meta is dark. Monitor weekly GBP call volume; if Meta is not reactivated by Oct 1, surface this to Sohib as the sole lead source and assess whether LSA (per the 7/19 call architecture) should be expedited. Re-check Oct 1.
